## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Ensure the destination treasury account has an active trustline for the token and can receive transfers.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = RefusingFixture::setup_quiet();
f.client.mock_all_auths().set_fee_bps(&f.governor, &100);
let _id = f.create(DEPOSIT, 0, 10 * DAY);
f.refuse(true, false);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_withdraw_treasury(
    &f.governor, &f.token, &f.recipient, &1,
));
```

This reproduction is derived from the contract's error surface tests in `error_surface_test.rs`.
